q: How many products are in each category?
sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY product_count DESC

q: What is the current stock level of each product?
sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, COALESCE(b.bought, 0) - COALESCE(s.sold, 0) AS stock FROM products p LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS bought FROM purchases GROUP BY product_id) b ON b.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS sold FROM sales GROUP BY product_id) s ON s.product_id = p.id ORDER BY stock DESC

q: Which products have never been sold?
sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales s WHERE s.product_id = p.id)
